reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and there's not a single review or track record in front of me, so I'm not putting $360 down on a first-home budget. That paper cloud pendant looks like something I could find for way less on Amazon or AliExpress.
objection: No reviews, no Trustpilot, no track record, and I'd be paying return shipping on a big fragile fixture if it turns up wrong. Plus it's the sort of light I can get cheaper elsewhere.
would_change_my_mind: A pile of real, verifiable customer reviews (Trustpilot or similar) with photos of this light, plus free return shipping or a price clearly below Amazon for the same fixture.
